description:
This is a pre-solicitation notice in accordance with (IAW) Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 5.101 and 12.201-1(c)(2).  THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS.

The Government intends to solicit this requirement directly from suppliers IAW RFO 12.201-1(c)(2) for firm-fixed price supply contract to procure two (2) new passenger buses for 374th Logistics Readiness Squadron (374 LRS), Yokota Air Base, Japan

Description: The Contractor shall provide all necessary personnel, supervision, management, tools, equipment, transportation, materials and any other items or services necessary to provide two (2) new passenger buses in accordance with commercial practice and local standards in the country of Japan.

Delivery Location:  Yokota Air Base, Tokyo, Japan

All offerors are required to have a Japanese Cage Code (J-type NCAGE) for maintenance and spare parts purposes.
